fields.label: Scan designer params
fields.tip: JSON dict passed to the scan designer.

fields.label: Line clock line
fields.tip: Digital line for line-clock output, e.g. Dev1/port0/line6. null if unused.

fields.label: Frame start clock
fields.tip: Digital line for frame-start clock output. null if unused.

fields.label: Point-scan panel
fields.tip: Options for the SimplePointScan panel, all optional: objectiveNA, nyquistPixelSizeUm, overviewAxes, overviewFieldUm, overviewMinFieldUm, overviewMinPixels, overviewMaxPixels, overviewFrameTimeS, minSamplesPerPixel, maxDwellMs.

fields.label: MoNaLISA panel
fields.tip: SimpleMoNaLISA setup and profiles. fovSource chooses detector-derived or manual FOV; defaultCameraReadoutTimeMs is inherited unless a profile defines cameraReadoutTimeMs; ulensPeriodPolicy chooses one fixed setup period or per-profile periods; readoutPulseTimeMs sets the setup-owned READOUT pulse duration (minimum 1 ms). Profiles define ordered ON/OFF/READOUT/CUSTOM steps and modes, plus scanExtentSource (one uLens period or manual scan extent). Setup and profiles can be edited and persisted from the Simple panel. With no profiles, the panel starts in a restricted create-profile state.
